verifier.method: Fresh route-scoped read of both exact PDF artifacts, their field map, actual-writes report, instructions, source receipt, route-acceptance and raster records, customer route contract, owner approval, post-approval change audit, product wiring and fulfillment-authority contract. All three source hashes and both artifact hashes were recomputed from bytes; page counts were parsed; all expected values were read from each artifact; all eight pages were rendered and visually inspected; route completeness was rerun; and the family builder was run twice from scratch without rastering. No earlier family verdict was inherited as a route verdict.

route.artifactFamilyOutput: process guidance and participant factual record; no petition and nothing filed

ROUTE_IDENTITY.finding: The route-acceptance row labels these bytes as the customer route, but the controlling customer route contract requires a participant petition from a distinct petition family. The reviewed family says repeatedly that it is guidance only, contains no petition, is filed nowhere, and must not close the petition gate. A one-route family/component equivalence cannot make the wrong output type the route's customer deliverable.

SOURCE_IDENTITY.finding: All three committed sources named by source-receipt.json exist and recompute byte-for-byte to the recorded SHA-256. All 25 anchors required by the builder resolve at this review base; no source binary is claimed.

COMPONENT_SET.finding: The customer route contract requires ten petition-family components. The reviewed artifacts carry only two guidance-family components. Both guidance components are valid for the guidance family, but neither turns that family into the customer route's petition packet.
requiredByCustomerRoute: Petition for retroactive First Offender treatment, exoneration and discharge
Written prosecutor consent, joinder or signed consent endorsement
Certificate of service or local notice document
Evidence of original First Offender eligibility
Post-order restriction, sealing and verification instructions

KNOWN_PREFILLS.finding: Six of six declared writes were independently read back from both canonical and boundary PDF text, using whitespace-normalized comparison for the wrapped boundary address. No declared write was missing.

REQUIRED_BEFORE_FILING.finding: All nine required-before-filing items declared by this guidance artifact are named in participant-instructions.md. The customer route's verified-written-consent precondition is also stated repeatedly, including that silence, refusal or no known objection is not consent and that LegalEase does not obtain consent.

ROUTE_OPTIONS.finding: The field map's sole route selection chooses process guidance and explicitly chooses no petition. The customer route contract selects participant_packet after verified written prosecutorial consent and requires a hearing-request election. The route-determined output selection therefore does not match the customer route.

REPEATING_ROWS.finding: The focused route-completeness run measured incompleteRows=0 for canonical and boundary artifacts.

PROTECTED_FIELDS.finding: The focused route-completeness run measured protectedWrites=0. The participant signature and signature-date lines remain blank in both PDFs, and the actual-writes record contains no court-, prosecutor- or participant-owned protected write.

ARTIFACTS.finding: Canonical and boundary bytes recompute to the hashes in rendered-artifacts.json, both route-acceptance rows, and the raster receipt. Each parses to four pages. Two fresh no-raster builds reproduced both hashes and left the worktree unchanged.

PAGE_ORDER.finding: Each PDF parses to four pages and its pageManifest is contiguous 1 through 4: participant factual record on pages 1-2, then process guidance on pages 3-4.

CLIPPING_AND_OVERLAP.finding: All eight pages were rendered and visually inspected. No text is clipped or overlapping. Independent bbox extraction found 0 words outside page bounds in either artifact; the central raster receipt is RASTER_PASS for the same canonical and boundary hashes with eight pages measured and zero problems.

FILING_DESTINATION.finding: The instructions accurately distinguish this non-filed guidance artifact from the eventual route: prosecuting attorney first for written consent, then the court of conviction for the petition.

FEE_AND_WAIVER.finding: The instructions state that O.C.G.A. § 42-8-66 prohibits a filing fee and therefore no fee waiver is needed.

SERVICE.finding: The reviewed guidance says nothing is served because nothing in it is filed. The customer route contract requires a certificate of service or local notice document for the post-consent petition. These artifacts contain no such component and do not state who the petition must be served on or how.

SELF_HELP_STOP.finding: The instructions stop self-help at prosecutorial-consent negotiation, refusal or silence, uncertain original eligibility, a contested evidentiary hearing and immigration consequences, and they name four Georgia referral desks. This content matches the current route contract; approval coverage for the post-approval addition is a separate failed operational condition recorded below.
